known_facts: At 10:04 UTC, the checkout error-rate alert fired with an increase in failures from 0.4% to 9%
Deployment dep-1842 for checkout-api completed at 10:01 UTC
Database latency increased at approximately the same time as the checkout errors
The external payment provider reported intermittent errors around this time
A previous incident with similar symptoms involved an expired service credential
assumptions: The increase in checkout error rate is not a normal fluctuation.
The deployment might have introduced changes that led to the increased database latency and checkout failures.
missing_information: Details of the code change included in dep-1842
Exact timestamps for when the database latency started increasing
Logs or traces showing a direct relationship between the deployment and the observed issues
The payment provider's internal logs to confirm if the reported errors were due to their end

candidate_hypotheses.hypothesis: The recent checkout-api deployment (dep-1842) introduced an issue that caused increased database latency and checkout failures.
supporting_evidence: Checkout error rate increased at the same time as the deployment
Database latency also increased around the same time
evidence_needed: Confirmation from logs or traces that directly link dep-1842 to the observed issues
Details of any code changes in dep-1842 that might explain the issues

candidate_hypotheses.hypothesis: The expired service credential is responsible for the increased checkout failures and database latency.
supporting_evidence: A previous incident had a similar issue with an expired service credential
Payment provider reported intermittent errors which could be due to the credential
evidence_needed: Confirmation from logs or traces that indicate the use of an expired credential at 10:04 UTC
Details on when and how long the credential was valid before expiration

candidate_hypotheses.hypothesis: The external payment provider's issues are causing increased checkout failures.
supporting_evidence: Payment provider reported intermittent errors around this time
evidence_needed: Details on the internal status of the payment provider and whether they can confirm their end is not at fault
Logs showing how the payment provider's issues could have impacted the checkout process

reversible_next_actions.action: Revert deployment dep-1842 to the previous stable version if evidence confirms it caused the problem.
reversible_next_actions.condition: If logs and traces confirm that dep-1842 introduced issues.

reversible_next_actions.action: Check for expired credentials in use by checkout-api.
reversible_next_actions.condition: If no other causes are found, check credential status around 10:04 UTC.

uncertainty_statement: The available evidence is insufficient to confirm the root cause. We need further investigation and more information to determine if dep-1842, expired credentials, or issues with the payment provider are the primary causes of the increased checkout error rate.
